Skip navigation Skip to main content Share Email X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit The Masters in Augusta Plan Your Masters Week Experience Beyond the Tournament The Masters Tournament returns to Augusta, Georgia, April 5-11, 2027 at Augusta National Golf Club. Each spring, Masters Week transforms Augusta into a global destination filled with golf tradition, Southern hospitality, and citywide excitement. While the tournament itself is played at Augusta National, the entire community comes alive with dining, shopping, events, and local experiences that make Masters Week unforgettable.
